packageRules.description: The modules in this repository are released by release-please, which owns their versions. A Renovate bump would race the release PR that produces one.

Group third-party Go minor and patch updates into one weekly PR. Per-module scopes would be noise: a shared dependency moves in every module at once, so the PR is about the dependency rather than about any one module.
Major Go updates one PR at a time, since each needs reading rather than merging.

grpc and protobuf move together with the checked-in stubs: a bump that changes generated output needs scripts/gen-proto.sh run in the same PR, which CI enforces. They are core's dependencies, so the scope is core.
Workflow action pins, grouped and typed as CI rather than as a dependency change.
The Go directive and toolchain are a deliberate choice across every module, not something to raise a PR for whenever a patch release lands.
